title: Native process lifecycle and isolation plane

previous_iteration_review.subject: feat(core): establish typed pure policy authority [MTM-002]
previous_iteration_review.working_tree_before_start: clean before the generated local-validation timestamp update
previous_iteration_review.result: The committed MTM-002 gate, 135-case differential corpus, frozen hash, source-reference cleanliness, resource ceiling and commit record all passed before MTM-003 entered in_progress.

authority.component_scope: MTM-reboot Native process, helper, isolation, toolchain, and owned tunnel component
authority.interpretation: Rust is the accepted implementation for the new project's Native component. Re-CTM's deployed Python runtime remains the operator-facing production and rollback authority until later composition and cutover milestones.

implemented: Bounded head-plus-rolling-tail capture with exact byte accounting
CommandManager with command ids, active/retained limits, paging, cursor omission accounting, TTY input, timeout watchdog, process-group TERM/KILL, parent shutdown and termination provenance
Generic system/PATH/symlink/explicit-root toolchain exposure policy with protected-domain rejection, ancestor collapse, sandbox PATH construction and content-minimized fingerprints
Separate re-ctm-native-helper-v1 Rust helper executable with bounded request/response, environment clearing, Bubblewrap namespace construction, attestation and synchronous execution
Real sandbox probe for workspace writability, private-path invisibility, parent-environment clearing, NoNewPrivs and read-only toolchain roots
Owned Quick Tunnel child lifecycle with credential stripping, strict TryCloudflare parsing, process-group cleanup and idempotent close
Persistent Rust shadow driver for exact and semantic Native differential testing

conformance.interpretation: A5 absolute and relative resource ceilings passed. Rust used substantially less resident memory but was slower in this small debug-build cold-process scenario, so no A6 speed claim is made.

covered: Safe workspace read and network namespace
Private-vault canary denial and parent-secret clearing
Host PATH/symlink discovery for target CAS roots
Python/Rust helper protocol parity for attest, execute and timeout
Real Quick Tunnel creation and owned-child cleanup

failures_retained.cause: The first draft had one unused import, test-only expect_err calls, a Bubblewrap builder with too many parameters, a const method incompatible with the declared MSRV, and a manually implemented Default.
failures_retained.resolution: Removed the unused import and panic-style tests, introduced BubblewrapCommandSpec, made the offset method non-const, and derived Default.

failures_retained.cause: read_output held the selected stream mutex and attempted to lock the same stream again while constructing dropped-byte fields.
failures_retained.resolution: Copied the selected stream metadata, dropped the guard, then acquired only the other stream lock; lifecycle and TTY tests subsequently completed.

failures_retained.cause: The reference hash included the random temporary fixture directory, so identical behavior produced a different hash on each run.
failures_retained.resolution: Normalized fixture paths to <FIXTURE_ROOT> before hashing and reproduced the same hash in consecutive runs.

failures_retained.stage: first real Quick Tunnel close audit
failures_retained.result: functional cleanup passed but event audit found duplicate terminal events
failures_retained.cause: Explicit close emitted closed, then Drop called close again and emitted a second closed event.
failures_retained.resolution: Made close idempotent, added a Rust regression test and required exactly one closed event in target acceptance.

failures_retained.cause: The governance test still expected the three-crate MTM-002 workspace and did not include mtm-native.
failures_retained.resolution: Updated the authoritative member expectation and added a freshness check for the hash-bound target evidence.

failures_retained.cause: The target-evidence validator worked as a standalone script but used a same-directory import that failed when the governance test imported it as scripts.validate_mtm003_target_evidence.
failures_retained.resolution: Added an explicit package-first import with a standalone-script fallback; the final completed-state gate passed.

failures_retained.cause: The first Rust unsafe-root list added /lost+found, which was not part of the frozen source policy; Bubblewrap hostname and HOME labels also used MTM-specific strings rather than the source wire values.
failures_retained.resolution: Removed the extra denial and restored the exact re-ctm-native hostname and /home/re-ctm sandbox HOME values.

acceptance.A0: passed: Rust format, Clippy -D warnings, workspace tests, governance tests, graph validators, conformance and Git checks
acceptance.A1: passed: exact toolchain/Bubblewrap construction, helper protocol parity and immutable Native reference SHA-256
acceptance.A2: passed: semantic command lifecycle parity for sync output, poll/read/kill, TTY, timeout and 600 KB retention with zero mismatches and no Git-visible shadow side effects
acceptance.A3: passed: bounded request/output, protected-root rejection, private-path denial, credential stripping, read-only roots, process ownership, timeout and kill negative paths
acceptance.A4: passed on the current Linux target: 14 hash-bound real boundary checks including Bubblewrap, SageMath, Magma and Quick Tunnel
acceptance.A5: passed: bounded elapsed time, RSS, active/retained process state and owned-child cleanup; no material unexplained regression

dependencies.review: nix is limited to Unix process groups and signals; no unsafe code is allowed in project crates. The external Bubblewrap and script(1) process boundaries are explicit, tested, and retained rather than hidden behind FFI.

rollback: Keep Re-CTM's Python CommandManager, toolchain policy, Bubblewrap helper and QuickTunnel as the deployed authority. Reverting MTM-003 deletes or bypasses mtm-native and its shadow/target harness; no SQLite, OAuth, workflow or artifact migration is involved.
manual_pending: Equivalent Native isolation and proprietary toolchain-layout acceptance on other target operating systems or machines
